capabilities: Renders declart code blocks as SVG diagrams
Supports nine diagram kinds such as flow, tier, hierarchy and timeline
Shows parse errors inside the block without affecting the note
extras: Marked desktop-only; not tested on mobile. Renders locally via bundled WebAssembly: no network requests, telemetry, or file access outside the vault. Node.js 22.18+ is needed only to build from source.
problem: Making diagrams in notes usually means managing colors, coordinates or fonts instead of just describing what to show.

relations.evidence: The renderer is the WebAssembly build published as @iyulab/declart-web

summary: Declarative diagram renderer that draws declart code blocks as SVG diagrams in Obsidian, the way Mermaid blocks render.
